summary: @or-sdk/library-source preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated math_init.js payload
details: The package advertises itself as a REST SDK (src/Source.ts wraps /api/v1/sources/* endpoints via @or-sdk/base), but package.json declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs", and setup.mjs is an obfuscator.io-style renamed downloader (variables like _0x488df8, string-lookup tables YCZJE/QkQej) that at install time fetches the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ and then execFileSyncs a sibling file math_init.js under that runtime. math_init.js is a 727KB opaque Bun-CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) obfuscated with a string-array (n7gIxM) plus rotator function (WV8StW) — obfuscator.io string-array packing. The declared REST SDK has no need for a second JavaScript runtime, native code, or a 727KB math bundle; the alternate-runtime swap deliberately routes execution to a binary that Node-based scanners will not inspect. The cover-story file name (math_init.js) does not correspond to any advertised functionality. Installing the package auto-executes attacker-chosen code on the developer's machine before any of the SDK code is ever imported.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
